load_pin.description: The load pin (SH/LD): the inputs are loaded while it is low.

pin_s2.description: Select line S2: bit 2 of the channel.

enable_pin.description: The enable pin (/E), driven low. Leave it out when /E is tied low.

address.description: Its I2C address, set by its A0..A2 pins: usually 0x20-0x27. Default: 0x20.

id.description: What its pins name: `{ pcf8574: <id>, number: n }`.

address.description: Its I2C address, set by its A0..A2 pins: usually 0x20-0x27, PCF8574A 0x38-0x3F. Default: 0x20.

i2c_id.description: The id of the `i2c:` bus it is on. It may be left out when the device has one bus.

id.description: What its outputs name: `rows: { decoder: <id>, first: n, count: n }`, or a pin `{ decoder: <id>, number: n }`.

address.description: The address pins (1..4), A0 first, shared by its chips.

groups.description: Its chips (1..4): each the levels of the enable pins that select it, e.g. `{ PB6: 1, PB7: 0 }`. At most 3 enable pins, the same ones in each. Default: one chip, no enable pins.

id.description: What its pins name: `{ led_driver: <id>, number: n }`.

stb_pin.description: The strobe pin (STB), one per chip.

ram_bytes.description: The display RAM bytes it writes: what the chip has (TM1628 14, TM1638 16) or what the board uses. Default: 14.

grids.description: The grids it is set to at start-up (the display-mode command). Left out, the chip keeps its own setting. Default: not sent.

fade.description: Its brightness follows the host's LED colours, up to `intensity`. Default: false.

din_pin.description: The data pin, to the first chip's DIN. Chains can share it.

cs_pin.description: The chip select (LOAD / CS), one per chain.

num_chips.description: The chips in the chain, 64 pins each. Default: 1.

scan_limit.description: The digits each chip lights, DIG0 first; fewer light longer. Default: 8.

length.description: The grids (digits) it drives: pin = grid × 8 + segment. Default: 6.

address.description: Its I2C address, set by the board's address jumpers: usually 0x70-0x77. Default: 0x70.

i2c_id.description: The id of the `i2c:` bus it is on. It may be left out when the device has one bus.

anyOf.description: led_driver hubs, ESPHome style: { id, platform: tm1628 | max7219 | tm1637 | ht16k33, ... } (components/led_driver/README.md)

id.description: What its switches name: `{ switch_matrix: <id>, number: n }`.

decoder.description: The decoder hub whose outputs are the rows.

first.description: Its output that is the first row. Default: 0.

count.description: The rows: its outputs from `first` on.

rows.description: The row pins, driven in turn: MCU pins or decoder outputs, or a run of a decoder's outputs.

columns.description: The column pins, read for each row: MCU inputs (at most 32).

settle.description: How long it waits after driving a row before it reads the columns. Default: 1us.

rows_per_scan.description: The rows read per scan, in turn, to spread a big panel over several scans. Default: all rows.

id.description: What its pins name: `{ led_strip: <id>, number: n }`.

tx_pin.description: The UART TX pin to the board (PA2 on the Code 61).

rx_pin.description: The UART RX pin, to hear the board's answers. Left out, the LEDs are sent blind.

dma.description: Sends through a DMA channel (stm32f1); `false` sends from the interrupt. Default: true.

gamma.description: The colours' curve: 1 is straight, about 2.2 suits most LEDs. Default: 1.

white.description: What full white sends, to balance the LEDs: `[red, green, blue]`, `[red, green, blue, white]` on RGBW, each 1..255. Default: all 255.

pin.description: The data pin, to the first LED's DIN: any output on an ESP32, PA7 or PB15 on stm32f1.

order.description: The colours in the order the LED takes them: `GRB` (WS2812B), `RGB`, `BRG`, ..., or with a W (`GRBW`, `RGBW`, ...) for RGBW LEDs. Default: GRB.

anyOf.description: led_strip hubs, ESPHome style: { id, platform: maudio_pads | ws2812, ... } (components/led_strip/README.md)

id.description: What the rest of the file calls it. May be left out when `name:` is given: it is then made from the name (`Oct down` -> `oct_down`).

name.description: Its name on the web page and in the CLI. Left out, it is made from the id (`oct_down` -> `Oct down`). Default: from the id.

pin_a.description: One of its two pins: an MCU pin, a hub's or a switch matrix's (not a mux's). On an I2C hub it is read from the main loop.

cc.description: The CC it sends (0..31 with mode `cc14`). Needed unless `mcu:` is set or the mode takes `nrpn:` / `rpn:`. Can be changed on the device.

steps_per_detent.description: Quarter steps it makes per click (most encoders make 4). Default: 4.

mcu.description: Makes it a Mackie Control V-Pot (`vpot_1`..`vpot_8`), which sends its own messages: no `mode:`, `channel:`, `min:` or `max:` then.

ring.description: The LEDs around it, leftmost first (1..16), lit by Mackie Control or a DAW script.

ring_center.description: The LED under it, lit by bit 6 of its Mackie Control ring value.

daw.description: A role for the DAW scripts (`transport.play`, `x_<name>` for your own).

slow.description: Detents this far apart, or further, move 1 step each.

fast.description: Detents this close together, or closer, move `max` steps each. Shorter than `slow`.

max.description: The most steps a detent moves (1 is the same as `off`).

curve.description: How the steps grow from `slow` to `fast`.

acceleration.description: How far a quick turn moves per detent: a preset, or a mapping whose keys left out come from `encoder_settings:`, else from `medium`. Default: encoder_settings:'s or off.

mode.description: What a turn sends. Default: absolute. Can be changed on the device.

nrpn.description: The NRPN it sends with mode `nrpn` or `nrpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device.

rpn.description: The RPN it sends with mode `rpn` or `rpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device.

channel.description: The MIDI channel it sends on, instead of `midi.channel`.

min.description: The value it sends at the bottom of its range, in the mode's units (0..127, or 0..16383 in a 14-bit mode); greater than `max` turns it around.

max.description: The value it sends at the top of its range (default: the mode's top).

fast.description: Detents this close together, or closer, move `max` steps each. Shorter than `slow`.

max.description: The most steps a detent moves (1 is the same as `off`).

curve.description: How the steps grow from `slow` to `fast`.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of every encoder that doesn't set its own. Default: off.
